findings.label: Extra test file beyond stated scope
findings.description: The change adds AwsClientProviderContextTest in addition to the eviction test. It is justified — it guards the @Autowired constructor-selection fix from a prior review pass against regression — and is not a defect. No action required.

findings.label: Test seams in production code
findings.description: putForTest and getExpireAfterAccessMinutesForTest are package-private methods on AwsClientProvider that exist only for tests. Acceptable per the plan and clearly comment-marked as test-only; flagged for awareness, not blocking.
